definitions.preimage_resistance: Given a digest, finding any input that hashes to it should be infeasible.
definitions.second_preimage_resistance: Given a particular input, finding a different input with the same digest should be infeasible.
definitions.collision_resistance: Finding any two different inputs with the same digest should be infeasible.

limit: No match in a bounded 10,000-candidate search does not prove a cryptographic resistance property. The one-bit experiment measures sample avalanche, not collision resistance.
